entries.name: Cozy Cafés
entries.content: The city is dotted with charming cafés that offer everything from romantic quiet nooks to lively social atmospheres. Available locations: Brew & Bloom, Pixel Roast, Sugarspell Café.

entries.name: Brew & Bloom
entries.content: Brew & Bloom is a garden-themed café with hanging plants, gentle harp music, and lavender lattes. Ideal for quiet blushes and shared desserts.

entries.name: Pixel Roast
entries.content: A tech-modern café with retro game-themed drinks, perfect for gamer couples to take a break mid-quest.

entries.name: Sugarspell Café
entries.content: Sugarspell Café is a cozy place with candle-lit booths and shelves of spellbooks and romance novels. Best spot for low-stakes flirting over chai.

entries.name: Adorable Parks & Trails
entries.content: Green spaces with flower gardens, lakeside benches, and walking paths ideal for romantic strolls or lighthearted teasing. Available locations: Willowshade Park, Juniper Vale, Foxglove Hill.

entries.name: Willowshade Park
entries.content: A peaceful green space with koi ponds, art sculptures, and willow trees swaying over cobbled paths. Birds often gather here.

entries.name: Juniper Vale
entries.content: Known for seasonal flowers, winding paths, and soft hilltops for lounging. Wild rabbits occasionally hop through.

entries.name: Foxglove Hill
entries.content: A grassy rise with a lone tree at the top and panoramic views of the city. Sunset kisses practically scripted.

entries.name: Romantic Hikes & Views
entries.content: Scenic routes and hidden paths perfect for stargazing, secret kisses, or shared snacks after a trek. Available Locations: Starview Ridge, Raventhorn Path, Glasspeak Ledge.

entries.name: Starview Ridge
entries.content: A quiet, forested trail leading to a wide plateau perfect for stargazing or secret dates.

entries.name: Raventhorn Path
entries.content: A narrow trail with streams, mossy rocks, and a little waterfall. Hidden from main roads.

entries.name: Glasspeak Ledge
entries.content: A crystal-clear view of the valley below, popular for dramatic speeches and passionate confessions.

entries.name: Couch Gaming Time
entries.content: Whether it's versus or co-op, game night means snacks, teasing, and possibly straddling someone while button-mashing.

entries.name: Movie Night at Home
entries.content: A warm blanket, your head on their shoulder, popcorn, and something 'totally not romantic' playing in the background.

entries.name: Seasonal Festivals
entries.content: Street fairs and seasonal events perfect for holding hands, winning plushies, and fireworks-backed confessions. Available locations: Lanternsong Festival, Crimson Bite Night Market, Starberry Bloom Festival.

entries.name: Lanternsong Festival
entries.content: Colorful paper lanterns float through the sky while couples exchange small charms.

entries.name: Crimson Bite Night Market
entries.content: Street food, red silk stalls, and flirty fortunes told by shady vendors.

entries.name: Starberry Bloom Festival
entries.content: Held in spring with flower crowns, dancing circles, and endless excuses to grab hands.

entries.name: Domestic Days Together
entries.content: Tasks like folding laundry, vacuuming together with music on, or one person cooking while the other hugs them from behind.

entries.name: Rainy Day Stay-In
entries.content: The world outside blurs to grey as the two of you curl up indoors. Book reading, nap piles, forehead kisses, and warm drinks.
